First, this dataset labels physician assistants as physicians, but the single holistic element reads PA language ('physician assistant studies', 'practice medicine under supervision') as nurse-adjacent, producing a consistent cluster of nurse predictions on PA bios that the human always overturns. Second, bare NPI/directory listings (NPI number, address, phone, no credentials or specialty) are mostly nurses in the labeled data, yet the holistic treats the registry format as physician-ish, so every such listing is predicted physician; a text-type element lets the model learn the correct base rate for that format.
